question: Which individual Attention question-Query interventions repair or reverse the old-recurrent-state / normal-KV readout effect, across every registered layer and question?
motivation: The completed fresh experiment gives GDN Full new-value NN32,NH3,HN32,HH2 out of32; HNvsHH gains30 new answers but loses1 fixed-prefix answer. Native rescue is mixed. All-layer replacement does not identify a causal layer, and normal GDN Full already reaches191/192. No new architecture is justified yet.
cohort_scope: Reuse all8fresh-query streams75000..75007,32after contexts and192after questions,3roles,2styles,both lengths8/64 and related/unrelated tails. No outcome-based sample,layer or model selection. This is a reused-cohort localization, not a fresh confirmation.

cache_origins.N: Normally encoded prefix followed by an entirely normal tail.
cache_origins.H: Independent fork of N after tail; replace only all18recurrent matrices with the same model/stream normal pre-tail matrices. Preserve normal convolution, all KV and complete after-tail bookkeeping. No gate suppression during tail.

reader_scope_reason: Localize ordinary full-history reading; the preceding Oracle matrix is retained as a privileged archived control, not used to choose layers or supply donor activations. No new Oracle inference or activation enters this phase.
query_capture: Only known question suffix at the fixed after-tail cache boundary. Capture actual post-q_norm/post-RoPE Query tensor passed to the native eager Attention dot product in each of6Attention layers. Capture interface accepts cache, known text/tokens and reader context, never answer, role, support-label lookup or generated tokens. No gold scoring or generation in capture.
capture_schedule: Rebuild all normal-prefix and N/H after-tail source caches for a stream, then capture both Full donors for all its after questions before any fresh answer scoring or generation. Verify every source cache and every donor tensor exactly against the predecessor run. No new data or weights.
query_replacement: Replace the actual post-q_norm/post-RoPE Query in exactly ONE registered Attention layer during the one known-question-suffix forward. Other layers use their actual native Query object, never a frozen recipient or donor Query. Later layers may change causally following the intervention. Keep actual local non-Query arguments unchanged by the wrapper; later answer/decode calls pass through unmodified.
references: Copy all1536Full NN/NH/HN/HH predecessor readouts with explicit archived-reference labels. Independently replay all1536 exactly, including all6-Query HN/NH and unpatched NN/HH. These are controls, not additional new scientific readouts.
same_source_controls: For each seed, choose lexicographically first and last after-question IDs using registration alone. For each of2models,2recipient origins and6single layers, actually copy that layer own donor Query, preserve all other actual Query objects and exactly replay its NN/HH baseline five fields and reader probabilities. All384controls retained; no accuracy gate. Smoke selects first/last within the original-style subset by the same rule.

operational_controls.cache: Complete actual48tensor inventory,metadata,layouts and genuine/absent logits. Preserve all historical KV and source storage after every capture/readout/control. Match every prefix and N/H source to predecessor. All caches and donor storage isolated.
operational_controls.query: Observe all6native eager layers, exactly1question call each. Exactly the registered layer copies an independent layout-preserving donor; all other question Query objects are passed unchanged at their own calls. Capture before answers and verify every actual tensor against the exact Full predecessor donor. Guard donor bytes and metadata after every use.
operational_controls.numerical: Same immutable native-BF16 kernel validation addendum and all10checks, same96legacycontrols, fixed native/adapter bytes and FP64-accumulate adapter arithmetic. Preserve ideal-FP32 failure; no new tolerance or accuracy gate.
operational_controls.runtime: No new environment,installation,model,training,checkpoint or token policy. All hooks/eager function/model parameters restored.

analysis.complete_reporting: All24new cells and8labelled archived Full cells,all192questions per cell,all96new episode cells,roles,styles,streams,fixed-prefix/new-tail evidence,Joint3/6 and every paired gain/loss. Preserve all prior baseline failures. Report single-layer contrasts against same-recipient baseline and all6-cross reference, both directions and both models.
analysis.limits: A single-layer rescue tests this intervention only; failure is not layer irrelevance, and success does not establish necessity or additivity. Later native Queries and question K/V may change causally; they must not be clamped to the predecessor. Donors contain upstream Attention and recurrent computations. Crossed activations may be off distribution. The cohort is reused, with only8independentstreams. No percent-mediated,significance,novelty or architecture-effectiveness claim and no scaleup gate.
